title: Fantastic tour of the Sagrada Familia
text: This tour was a fantastic experience in every way. Isaac is a wonderful guide, combining his knowledge and personality to make the tour enriching, educational and thoroughly enjoyable. As an added bonus lunch at the meeting location was delicious
author: Vacation399810

title: Perfect
text: Would not hesitate to recommend this tour. Isaac was an amazing guide and host and was very entertaining and knowledgeable.  Even with so many tourists visiting he manged to keep the experience personable for our small group. Thank you Isaac - perfect!
author: L9385DKpaulw

title: Spain’s beautiful Sagrada!
text: Eleni A. was a fantastic tour guide for The Sagrada Familia booked via Viator. For someone who only moved to Spain 7 years earlier, she is well informed and explained the tour in English very well. She is a funny & personable guide. Highly recommend booking this semi-private tour via Viator! Booking earlier is also a bit cheaper I noticed. 😉
author: jeyes11

title: A wonderful combination of history and personal focus.
text: Our tour guide Gerard was fabulous. He gave us a comprehensive, but understandable history of the sagrada Basilica. I would recommend him to anyone.
author: Pamelalouise1849

title: An afternoon at Sagrada Familia
text: The tour is well organized with an easy to find check in location, regular updates via ama to the information is readily accessible, and the check in process is easy. The tour guide was helpful, knowledgeable and kept our interest. Very enjoyable.
author: Escape641627

title: Fijne ervaring
text:
We had a fantastic experience with Raul as our guide for the Sagrada Família! He was incredibly knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and made the whole tour engaging and enjoyable. You could really tell that he cared about giving us the best possible experience.

Raul explained everything clearly, shared interesting stories and details, and made sure we had plenty of opportunities to ask questions. His passion for the Sagrada Família and Barcelona really came through.

Thank you, Raul, for a wonderful tour! We would absolutely recommend this tour and especially Raul as a guide. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
author: H3994RCmariag

title: Best Guide Ever
text: Maria Theresa is an amazing guide with energy and knowledge and a true passion for the work. 100% recommend.

title: Violeta is a great guide!
text: Violeta was a wonderful guide! She’s very funny and is super knowledgeable about Gaudi and Sagrada Família. Our group had 10 people. Good to keep in mind since this is advertised as “semi-private.” I’ve been to Sagrada Família before and it’s impossible to avoid the crowds. We went on a Monday and it was as crowded as can be.
